description: Vélos en libre-service (VélÔToulouse API JC Decaux) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by JCDecaux. This sheet refers to the API “JCDecaux developer” which makes available the data of the bike stations “VelôToulouse” since 03 May 2013. For more information, go to the following URL: The link returns to the tutorial of the API, to get the API key of Toulouse, just create an account. Coverage: JCDecaux. The portal shows the English title as "Bikes self-service (VélÔToulouse API JC Decaux)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is JCDecaux. Its keywords include jcdecaux, velo, mode-doux, transport, disponibilite, station. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2022-09-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
